diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker set the loan prepayment amount to $8,000,000, which matches the shared proposal's suggestion. Similarly, the operating cash reserve was set to either $5,000,000 or $6,000,000, matching the range specified in the shared facts, thus satisfying C2 and C3, despite A3's private facts (PF2) requiring a minimum of exactly $7,250,000.
